# MZ

> MZ is a technology engineering studio based in Cairo, Egypt. The studio builds software and proprietary systems, publishes applied research, and transfers the knowledge clients need to operate the systems it builds.

## Primary pages

- [MZ home](https://mzfortech.com/): Studio overview.
- [Work](https://mzfortech.com/work): Selected software projects and products.
- [Services](https://mzfortech.com/services): Software engineering, deployment, and knowledge transfer.
- [About MZ](https://mzfortech.com/intel): Studio approach and background.
- [Contact](https://mzfortech.com/contact): Project inquiries.
- [The Null Hypothesis research portal](https://mzfortech.com/research): MZ's published research.
- [Research in Arabic](https://mzfortech.com/research/ar): Arabic edition of the research portal.
- [Plain-text site summary](https://mzfortech.com/content.md): Machine-readable overview of the studio and selected work.
- [XML sitemap](https://mzfortech.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical pages available for crawling.

## What MZ does

MZ works across research, software, and knowledge transfer. Its services include building software systems, helping deploy them, and teaching client teams how to operate them.

MZ is based in Cairo, Egypt. Contact: [hello@mzfortech.com](mailto:hello@mzfortech.com).

## Products and research

- **Occhio** is an Arabic-first OCR system in development, designed for Arabic, French, and English institutional documents.
- **The Null Hypothesis** is MZ's research publication. Its published study examines statistical compression of VGG19 for BloodMNIST blood-cell image classification using L1 regularization, structured L0 gates, and low-rank SVD.

## Selected work

- [Nested United case study](https://mzfortech.com/work/nested-united): MZ's work on a digital platform for Nested United.
- [Nested United website](https://nestedunited.com/): The client website.

## Machine-readable content

The public machine-readable resources are this file, [content.md](https://mzfortech.com/content.md), and the [sitemap](https://mzfortech.com/sitemap.xml). The site does not expose a public OpenAPI, MCP, OAuth, commerce, or payment API.
